description: This file defines the VoiceWakeManager class responsible for managing voice wake word detection, speech recognition, and microphone permissions in an iOS app. It includes audio buffer handling, recognition pipeline setup, and permission requests.

classes.name: AudioBufferQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue for audio buffers, supporting enqueue, drain, and clear operations.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice wake word detection, speech recognition, and microphone permissions, including starting/stopping recognition and handling recognition results.

methods.name: makeAudioTapEnqueueCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback to enqueue audio buffers into the queue.

methods.name: AudioBufferQueue.enqueueCopy
methods.description: Enqueues a deep copy of an audio buffer into the queue.

methods.name: AudioBufferQueue.drain
methods.description: Drains all buffers from the queue and returns them.

methods.name: AudioBufferQueue.clear
methods.description: Clears all buffers from the queue.

methods.name: AVAudioPCMBuffer.deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the audio buffer, supporting float, int16, and int32 channel data.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.init
methods.description: Initializes the voice wake manager, setting up trigger words and user defaults observer.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.deinit
methods.description: Removes user defaults observer on deinitialization.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.configure
methods.description: Sets the callback to execute when a wake command is recognized.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the voice wake functionality, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.setSuppressedByTalk
methods.description: Temporarily suspends recognition for external audio capture.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.start
methods.description: Begins the recognition process, requesting permissions and configuring audio session.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.stop
methods.description: Stops recognition and disables the manager.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.suspendForExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Suspends recognition to allow external audio capture, returning true if active recognition was suspended.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.resumeAfterExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Resumes recognition after external audio capture if it was suspended.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and starts the speech recognition pipeline.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.tearDownRecognitionPipeline
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the recognition pipeline.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.makeRecognitionResultHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler for processing recognition results.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.handleRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Processes recognition results, handles errors, and triggers commands.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts command from transcript based on trigger words.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.configureAudioSession
methods.description: Configures the AVAudioSession for recording.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.requestMicrophonePermission
methods.description: Requests microphone permission with timeout.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.microphonePermissionMessage
methods.description: Generates message based on microphone permission status.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.requestSpeechPermission
methods.description: Requests speech recognition permission with timeout.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.requestPermissionWithTimeout
methods.description: Handles permission requests with a timeout.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.permissionMessage
methods.description: Generates permission message based on speech recognizer status.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.deniedByDefaultPermissionMessage
methods.description: Generates default permission denial message.
